calls.statement:
WITH act AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
tier AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.tier, m.join_date FROM dim_member m
  WHERE m.valid_from <= DATE '2025-12-21' AND m.valid_to >= DATE '2025-12-21'
)
SELECT t.tier, COUNT(DISTINCT a.member_id) AS n, COUNT(*) AS rows_, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM act) AS total_act,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.join_date > DATE '2025-12-21' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_after
FROM act a LEFT JOIN tier t ON t.member_id = a.member_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement: SELECT tier, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), MIN(valid_from), MAX(valid_to) FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS unfiltered,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' THEN m.member_id END) AS filtered,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN m.member_id END) AS in999,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN m.member_id END) AS inzz,
 COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.member_id IS NULL THEN f.sales_line_id END) AS unmatched_member_key
FROM fact_sales_line f
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND f.sale_date > DATE '2025-12-21' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2025-12-21'
